description: Add surgeons by NPI to one of the rep's prospect lists (by id or name), or make a new list with them when no list matches. Use when the user asks to save targets from rank_territory, new_surgeons or warm_paths. The plan limits how many lists; up to 500 surgeons each.

list.description: An existing list's id or name to add to.

name.description: Name for a new list, or an existing list's name to add to it.

name: save_to_list
title: Save surgeons to a list
